name: Bailor Stonehand
summary: In Thelsamar, Bailor Stonehand waits on ore shipments stolen by Mo'grosh ogres. The skilled dwarven smith crafts a specialized alloy for masterwork armaments and once taught the human weaponsmith Jordan Stilwell.

sections.title: Master of the Forge
sections.body: Bailor Stonehand tends the forge in Thelsamar. His knowledge of minerals and specialized alloys reaches beyond Khaz Modan. He taught Jordan Stilwell the foundations of metallurgy and shared formulas for blessed paladin armaments such as Verigan's Fist.

sections.title: Ogre Ambush
sections.body: Mo'grosh ogres in the hills northeast of Thelsamar stole ore shipments bound for Bailor's forge. Without the raw material, he cannot make his rare alloys. He needs travelers and allies to recover the supplies from the ogres' encampments.

faq.answer: Bailor Stonehand is a veteran dwarven smith in Thelsamar, Loch Modan. He smelts rare metal alloys and taught Jordan Stilwell the craft of weaponsmithing.

faq.q: What is Bailor's connection to Jordan Stilwell?
faq.answer: Bailor taught Jordan Stilwell, a human smith near Ironforge, to work refined ore. He also taught him a special alloy used to make the holy warhammer Verigan's Fist.
Mo'grosh ogres in Loch Modan's northeastern mounds intercepted and stole Bailor's raw ore shipment. He has no materials for his specialized metalwork.

faq.q: Where can Bailor Stonehand be found?
faq.answer: Bailor can be found near the center of Thelsamar, the main dwarven town along Loch Modan's main road.

angles.text: As a paladin, you follow a craft Bailor taught Jordan Stilwell. His specialized alloy formula is used to make the sacred hammer Verigan's Fist.
As a blacksmith, you can see Bailor's pursuit of rare, resilient metals. His specialized alloys are known across Khaz Modan.
